scope: Private metadata collaboration preview; local workers and Git source exchange

implementation.transport: Authenticated typed HTTP commands and long polling
implementation.persistence: Fsynced relay journal before ACK; private durable client outbox and separate received/read cursors
implementation.identity: Invitation-capability preview, not verified Memtrace organization membership
implementation.publishedFiles: Explicit selection; 5 MiB per file, authenticated content-addressed bytes

checks.nativeDesktopSmoke: passed, including isolated guest RPC denial and graceful shutdown
checks.isolatedTeamUiFlows: passed, including LAN opt-in, join, invitation, result publish/open, read cursor, own claim release, offline, old runtime and responsive Docs

nativeTeamAcceptance.platform: Windows native WebView2; two independent profiles on one physical machine

faultScenarios: lost command ACK deduplicates after relay restart
lost claim ACK retries the same persisted attempt
disconnected owner does not silently grant another device ownership
semantic rejection does not block a later valid comment
rejected deletion restores private messages, runbook, reviews and planning history after restart
private authoritative ACK survives a stale workspace.json crash window
missing private credentials retain the shared-project marker and block unclaimed worker starts
Share versus Start transition cannot leave a worker outside claims
direct and automatically queued starts use the claim guard for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
parent stories and comments bootstrap before their children
concurrent new story identifiers are canonicalized atomically
checks.sourcePrivacyReview: Ignored private profiles, credentials, generated outputs and scratch files excluded; no high-confidence credential patterns detected in source or existing Git history

verificationNote: One initial full-suite run hit the existing 15-second queued follow-up polling deadline. The file passed independently and the complete final suite passed; the final changed runtime and queue suite also passed. No timeout was extended to mask it.
limitations: No test on two physical computers yet
No macOS build or runtime acceptance yet
Native shared agent browser and visible-preview capture remain Windows-specific
No remote public relay deployed or tunnel enabled
No verified team-account identity, revocation, cross-device forced handoff or cross-user Fleet
No full conversation, browser/terminal session, linked website asset bundle or uncommitted source replication
Team worker tests use fixture adapters and real runtime guards, not new paid model coding runs
Relay host must remain reachable; setup/create/join responses do not yet have command-style retry idempotence
